q1_issues.issue: football_player is a fused modifier_noun compound whose head-noun genus (Inheritance football_player player) is specified as always emitted, but it is missing, so a football_player instance is not derivably a player.

notes: The agent-nominalization pair — capability (Inheritance football_player (can play)) plus the incorporated-object kind relation (Play football_player football) — is correctly fired on a symbol fused from the surface, and the noun modifier 'football' is correctly not exposed as a genus. Note a tension in the instruction set: the 'Hens are egg-layers' example likewise shows no (Inheritance egg_layer layer), while the Compound-kind rule states the head-noun genus is always emitted.
